name: Bright
idea: A light deck warmed by one soft gradient of the accent, two-tone headlines, rounded cards and big confident numbers.
brief: A modern investor template (the owner's references, 2026-10-09). A white or near-white ground, warmed by one large soft glow of the accent (dd-glow) on most slides, from a corner or behind a column; sometimes a whole slide sits on the accent with white text. Headlines in a clean grotesk, sentence or title case, two-tone: the key words in the accent, the rest in ink. Numbers are big and light-weight ('+48.5', '250+'), with a short label. Cards are rounded, some filled with the accent, one standing taller than the rest; small page chrome top left (the deck's name — the year) and top right (Page 03). Pictures are abstract 3D renders of soft ribbons in the accent.

styles: abstract 3D render of smooth folded ribbons and soft waves in the accent colour, glossy, soft light, plain background
